_comment: Product and architecture questions, a separate frozen schedule on fresh maps (never the primary's). Six prespecified overall contrasts, one family, Bonferroni: each judged on a two-sided 1 - 0.05/6 interval (z = 2.638, from the analyze.py estimate and standard error); bands and per-count rows are descriptive. L = large-V-trained actor, S = small-V-trained actor (both sampled actor-direct), Q = L's actor with the bounded value search of the large V (Q~aa its A/A copy). 'meowmind_p3_distill_xxl - meowmind_p3_xxl' is the in-game test of distillation (T0032's 8XL teacher) on one carrier: if it is not shown, a larger P2 teacher has no game evidence behind it either. Whole-bot comparisons (different carriers) answer product questions, not mechanisms.
